compass.description: Your general task hub. Describe the outcome and I will route it to the right specialist.

1.description: Break down goals, steps, timing, and deliverables
1.prompt: I want to complete [goal]. Choose the right assistant, ask only for essential details, and create an actionable plan.
1.title: Plan a task

2.description: Read approved files and summarize what matters
2.prompt: Help me organize [file or folder] on this computer. Tell me what to select, then summarize themes and action items.
2.title: Organize local files

3.description: Weigh cost, risk, and expected results
3.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] by cost, outcome, risk, and fit, then make a clear recommendation.
3.title: Compare options

4.description: Turn a request into a document, table, or checklist
4.prompt: Turn my request into a usable [document, table, or checklist]. First confirm the audience and delivery format.
4.title: Create a deliverable

content.description: Plan topics and turn ideas into publishable writing and social content.

1.description: Define audience, angle, and a content series
1.prompt: Plan topics about [subject]. Confirm the platform, audience, and goal, then give me 10 specific ideas with reasons.
1.title: Plan topics

2.description: Write an article, post, or spoken script
2.prompt: Draft a [platform] piece about [subject]. Confirm audience, tone, and length, then provide an editable first draft.
2.title: Draft content

3.description: Refine structure, voice, title, and opening
3.prompt: Improve the copy I provide while preserving its facts and intent. Focus on the title, opening, structure, and pace.
3.title: Improve a draft

4.prompt: Create a [period] content calendar for [account or brand], including themes, dates, required assets, and goals.
4.title: Content calendar

ecommerce.description: Solve product, store, and conversion problems with practical operating materials.

1.description: Clarify audience, pain points, and differentiation
1.prompt: Develop selling points for [product]. Confirm the audience, price range, and competitors, then provide layered claims and proof.
1.title: Product selling points

2.description: Compare price, content, and customer feedback
2.prompt: Analyze [competitor] across positioning, price, claims, page content, and reviews, then identify differentiation opportunities.
2.title: Competitor review

3.description: Build titles, benefits, proof, and conversion flow
3.prompt: Design product-page copy for [product], including the hero, key benefits, proof, scenarios, and call to action.
3.title: Product page copy

4.description: Cover presales, objections, payment, and support
4.prompt: Create customer-service scripts for [product or store], covering presales, price objections, payment, shipping, and after-sales.
4.title: Customer service scripts

family.description: Plan home, family, and parenting tasks with clear, practical steps.

1.description: Match household size, budget, and shopping
1.prompt: Create a weekly meal plan for [household size, preferences, and budget], with a combined shopping list and prep advice.
1.title: Weekly meal plan

2.description: Plan routes, timing, cost, and alternatives
2.prompt: Plan a family trip to [destination]. Confirm travelers, dates, and budget, then provide an itinerary, costs, and rain plan.
2.title: Family trip

3.prompt: Design a [duration] activity for a [child age], including goals, materials, steps, and safety notes.
3.title: Parent-child activity

4.prompt: Turn [household task] into an actionable plan with timing, owner assignments, required items, and reminders.
4.title: Household plan

office.description: Turn documents, spreadsheets, meetings, and source material into polished deliverables.

1.description: Build a formal document from source material
1.prompt: Turn my source material into a [document type]. Confirm the audience and purpose, then produce a clear structure and draft.
1.title: Prepare a document

2.description: Clean, analyze, and summarize business data
2.prompt: Process the spreadsheet I provide. Explain what can be read, then clean it, analyze key metrics, and summarize findings.
2.title: Analyze a spreadsheet

3.prompt: Turn these meeting notes into minutes with decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and open questions.
3.title: Meeting notes

4.description: Develop an outline, key points, and slide flow
4.prompt: Create a presentation outline for [topic]. Confirm the audience, goal, and duration, then give slide-by-slide points and data needs.
4.title: Presentation brief

research.description: Organize evidence, compare viewpoints, and build learning plans while making uncertainty visible.

1.prompt: Research [topic]. Confirm scope and recency requirements, then summarize reliable sources, findings, and open questions.
1.title: Quick research

2.prompt: Compare different views on [question], including evidence, disagreements, applicable conditions, and a balanced conclusion.
2.title: Compare viewpoints

3.prompt: Create a learning plan for [topic] based on my current level, available time, and goal, with stages, resources, and exercises.
3.title: Learning plan

4.description: Extract concepts, evidence, and next actions
4.prompt: Summarize the material I provide, separating facts, author claims, and your inferences, then list key concepts and actions.
4.title: Summarize sources

video.description: Create scripts, shot plans, and editing directions that can move straight into production.

1.description: Plan spoken lines, visuals, and pace
1.prompt: Write a [platform and duration] shooting script about [topic], including hook, spoken lines, visual cues, and call to action.
1.title: Shooting script

2.description: Define shot size, camera, action, and timing
2.prompt: Turn my script into a storyboard with shot number, framing, visual, dialogue, camera, duration, and transition.
2.title: Storyboard

3.description: Organize scenes, props, and shooting order
3.prompt: Create a shot list for [topic], grouped into an efficient order, with people, props, equipment, and cautions.
3.title: Shot list

4.description: Set structure, transitions, captions, and music
4.prompt: Create an editing plan for [video topic], covering pacing, clip selection, transitions, captions, sound, and music.
4.title: Editing plan

setup.tokenHint: Verwenden Sie den gemeinsamen Gateway-Token. Bei der ersten Remote-Verbindung kann eine Geraetefreigabe erforderlich sein.
setup.urlHint: ws:// fuer lokal, wss:// fuer entfernte Verbindungen mit TLS. Format: ws[s]://hostname:port
